race.comment: BEYOND MEASURE (1) showed enough in his debut campaign, tackling Open 3YO company here before the break where he was only 1L away. His two trials this time in have been awesome and the form out of his run before the break stood up. Can return with a bang. ENCROACHING (4) tackled Open 2YO company in his debut campaign and wasn't disgraced in Saturday company. He's shown enough in his past couple of trials to suggest he's back in good order and Chris Parnham sticks from those heats. Sure to make his presence felt. MISS AJAX (14) has been competitive in stronger Belmont Park company, with her debut third behind Rifleman reading well. Out in trip now looks a good move and she can bounce back off her last start effort. BONDEX (5) made sharp improvement when beaten a neck at this track after being bumped on jumping. Won't be far away. PASSIONENUFF (12) has trialled nicely coming in and can't be discounted.
